answer: Sybil resistance here uses stake-weighted identity anchored to a physical orchard: each agent must plant and maintain a verifiable orchard plot whose harvest is recorded on-chain, binding identity to land. Registering fake agents means buying real plots, a costly barrier. A nebula-like reputation cloud then scores plots, and only holders of a rare marble token minted from proven harvests can vote on epochs, making mass fake accounts economically irrational.
